offering_description.value: Global alternative investment manager that raises and manages funds for institutional and retail investors. Its main strategies are credit, real estate, private equity and secondaries, plus infrastructure. It earns fees by deploying client capital into these assets.

primary_products.value: private credit funds; real estate equity and debt funds; private equity funds; secondaries funds; infrastructure funds

primary_services.value: asset management; investment advisory; fund administration; capital markets and fund distribution support

customer_segment.value: B2B: pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, insurance companies, endowments, foundations, family offices; B2C: high-net-worth and retail investors via wealth platforms and non-traded vehicles

end_markets.value: institutional investing; wealth management; private credit and lending; real estate; insurance asset management

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: management fees on committed and invested capital, plus performance fees and carried interest; interest or premiums: investment income from balance sheet and fund investments
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: raises capital from investors and allocates it to loans, real estate, companies and infrastructure assets

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and the Middle East, with US the largest base

specialization.value: related lines: credit, real estate, private equity, secondaries and infrastructure strategies sharing an investor base

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house fundraising teams selling to institutional investors; partners / resellers: wealth management platforms and distributors for retail and high-net-worth investors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: registered investment adviser under SEC and Investment Advisers Act, also FCA, ESMA and other regulators, broker-dealer rules

notes: Strategy mix and recent acquisitions may have shifted; description is from general knowledge.
